Evaluation of a web-based tertiary statistics course using a problem-based learning approach /
Faculty of Cognitive Science and Human Development.

A compulsory postgraduate statistics course was delivered as a Web-based course using the problem-based learning approach at Universiti Malaysia Sarawak. In this course, the 26 participants were presented with authentic problems that they tackled in small groups via computer conferencing. Quantitative and qualitative methods including questionnaires, interviews, e-mail messages, and computer conferencing transcripts were used to evaluate the effects of this mode of teaching. In particular, this study was interested in the participants' satisfaction with and achievement in the learning environment the participants attitudes toward statistics the relationships between course satisfaction and achievement with participants' characteristics and instructional variables and evidence oc critical thinking.

Incorporating genetic algorithm into simulated annealing based redistricting /

Redistricting is a process of drawing lines as a boundary, it plays an important role in the process of decision making on space and spatial allocation. In redistricting, the main problem to be solved is to find the districting plan that maximizes the value function involved. Thus, redistricting process can be characterized as a combinatorial optimization problem and considered to be computationally intractable or NP-hard problem, so getting trapped in local optimal and difficulty in obtaining the most optimal solution have became the great challenge of redistricting problem. Latest approach of solving redistricting problem using simulated annealing has shown a significant improvement with ability to escape from local optimal.
Molecular assessment of antimalarial drug resistance in plasmodium falciparum isolates from Lundu, Sarawak /
Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences.

The in vivo response was measured by the World Health Organization (WHO) 28-day in vivo assessment of antimalarial treatment. Briefly, for the molecular study, blood-spot samples on filter paper were collected following the schedule for in vivo assessment. Nester PCR for the detection of Plasmodium parasites species and detection of mutations associated with drug resistance was carried out on DNA extracted from the blood-spot samples.
